dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If she'd like to go see a rock 'n' roll concert.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Ah, Ms. Yun... Whenever she wants to go out to see a rock concert, she has to find some excuse to prevent those old codgers in the troupe from finding out.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Imagine that, eh? A man at my age, going along with various deceptions, exchanging code-words, doing things in secret...
